keyFindings.description: collectAskHosts finds a shell's slots with shell.querySelector('[data-dispatch-ask-header]') / ('[data-dispatch-ask-footer]'), which search every descendant in document order. An ask block may sit inside an option of another ask block (list_item holds blocks), and the inner shell's footer comes before the outer shell's own footer, so the outer card mounts in the inner footer, the outer is marked data-dispatch-ask-options=rows and its source list (holding the inner block) is folded: the outer decision shows only its header, no options, and the inner decision is hidden. Reproduced by the reviewer in happy-dom at 9439f4a8 (throwaway test, deleted): shells 2, outer own footer empty, shell 1 footer text 'AfirstInner?X: xXx'. Fix: ':scope > [data-dispatch-ask-header]' and ':scope > [data-dispatch-ask-footer]' (and the same in ask-block.ts slot() to keep the two in step), plus a MarkdownBody.test.tsx case for a decision nested in an option.

Fast-follow (no behaviour change): the shell's stamped attributes (urgency, state, malformed) and the fold rule (not malformed means data-dispatch-ask-options=rows) are written in renderAskBlockShell, AskBlockView.applyShell and collectAskHosts; askBlockShell could return the attribute record and the fold decision once, and the DOM write could leave collectAskHosts.
